第51章 华语乐坛神仙打架的时代-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

6月15号，上戏602宿舍。

“快快快，MV发布了！！”

“我看看。”

“我靠，陈贺你电脑怎么这么卡，网页一直在转圈圈！！”

“这能怪我？是学校网络太辣鸡！！”

小小的电脑桌前，挤满了三个壮汉。

视频一直没加载出来，郑凯只好坐回自己的床上。

“现在是用网高峰期，我们再等等吧。”

他们学校不是老古董，宿舍在去年便已全面接入互联网，就是网络不太行。

这年头校园网普遍采用ADSL或LAN技术，带宽多为1-2M。

平常的时候还好，现在是晚上7点，正好赶上学生在宿舍休息，不卡才怪。

“我就是想看看女主角长什么样子，听说是中戏的？”

“对，长得很高。”

陈贺露出猥琐笑容。

“老魏还是爽啊，自导自演，把人家女主角亲懵了。”

“好了！！”

一直守在电脑前的杜姜喊了一嗓子。

另外两人闻风而动。

只见电脑屏幕慢慢亮起，随之响起的还有低沉的钢琴曲。

熟悉的歌曲前奏，让整个宿舍安静下来。

绚丽的京城夜景下，浮现一行文字。

词：魏沐

曲：魏沐

画面消失，紧跟着男主角魏沐出现，他躺在沙发上眼睛看着对面。

下一秒，镜头再次切换，拎着行李箱的女主角糖嫣现身。

画面定格一秒，歌曲名字出现——体面/魏沐

“靠。真装逼，一共三秒，他的名字出现3次！！”

郑凯羡慕的感慨了一句，恨不得上面全是他的名字。

“切，你也可以和老魏一样，作词作曲做导演啊。”

作为宿舍头号魏吹，陈贺为好兄弟站台。

三个人之中，只有杜姜在认真看。

他发现这个MV和其他MV有点不一样。

画面干净，漂亮，没有多余的东西。

剪辑恰到好处，故事流畅。

开头交代男女主分手，然后闪回到刚认识，再闪回分手之前的状态。

这样来回穿插，把剧情一点点铺出来。

除此之外，男女主妆造贴合时间线。

年轻时热恋的妆容和分手时的妆容完全不一样。

“记住啦，我对芒果过敏。”

“好。”

......

Chapter 51 The era of fighting between gods in the Chinese music scene - "China Entertainment 2008: Starting from a happy breakup"

On June 15th, I went to dormitory 602.

"Hurry, hurry, the MV is released!!"

"Let me see."

"Damn it, Chen He, why is your computer so stuck? The web page keeps spinning in circles!!"

"Can you blame me? The school network is too hot!!"

Three strong men were crowded in front of the small computer desk.

The video never loaded, so Zheng Kai had to sit back on his bed.

"Now is the peak period for Internet use, let's wait."

Their school is not old-fashioned. The dormitories were fully connected to the Internet last year, but the network is not very good.

These days, campus networks generally use ADSL or LAN technology, and the bandwidth is mostly 1-2M.

It's fine under normal circumstances, but now it's 7pm, just in time for students to rest in the dormitory, so it's strange that it's not stuck.

"I just want to see what the heroine looks like. I heard that she is in a drama?"

"Yes, very tall."

Chen He showed a lewd smile.

"Lao Wei is still very happy. He directed and acted himself, and the heroine was stunned by his kiss."

"Okay!!"

Du Jiang, who had been staying in front of the computer, shouted.

The other two people heard the news and took action.

I saw the computer screen slowly light up, followed by low piano music.

The familiar prelude of the song made the whole dormitory fall silent.

Under the gorgeous night view of the capital, a line of text appeared.

Words: Wei Mu

Music: Wei Mu

The screen disappeared, and then the male protagonist Wei Mu appeared. He was lying on the sofa and looking at the opposite side.

The next second, the camera switched again, and the heroine Tang Yan appeared carrying a suitcase.

The screen freezes for a second, and the song name appears - Decent/Wei Mu

"Damn. What a show, his name appeared three times in three seconds!!"

Zheng Kai sighed with envy, wishing that his name was all over it.

"Tch, you can also be like Lao Wei, composing lyrics, composing music, and directing."

As Wei Chui, the number one in the dormitory, Chen He stands up for his good brothers.

Among the three people, only Du Jiang was watching seriously.

He found that this MV was a little different from other MVs.

The picture is clean, beautiful, and nothing superfluous.

The editing is just right and the story flows smoothly.

At the beginning, the hero and heroine break up, then flash back to when they first met, and then flash back to the state before the breakup.

This way of interweaving back and forth unfolds the plot bit by bit.

In addition, the male and female main makeup looks fit the timeline.

The makeup you wear when you are young and in love is completely different from the makeup you wear when you break up.

"Remember, I'm allergic to mangoes."

"Okay."
